_note: Public template. Copy to axon-overlay/config/transit.json and fill real values there — never here. transit resolves config from $SJEL_PERSONAL_ROOT/config/transit.json at runtime (see src/config.rs Config::load).
_comment_defaults: Optional conveniences. default_from_eva also backs `plan --from` (Phase 3). Set your own home route so `search`/`split`/`plan` run with fewer flags. Leave unset and the CLI requires --from/--to explicitly (errors with a clear message rather than silently defaulting to someone else's stations).
_comment_document_backend: Which reader turns a ticket file into text. "builtin" (default) uses pdf_extract/mailparse and cannot read an image. "xberg" shells out to the xberg CLI (cargo install xberg-cli), which reads images and 100+ formats. Measured 2026-08-11: xberg recovers a key-value block as a Markdown table but NOT a journey table, so it is adopted for the image path rather than as a parsing fix. ocr_language is Tesseract's ISO 639-3 code; the English default reads German umlauts as noise.
